headline: AUM alone still winning every conference match
dek: AUM beat Christian Brothers on Saturday for a sixth win in seven matches, and their one defeat came outside the conference. UAH and Trevecca, behind them in the table, are still the only programmes yet to lose a match at all.
displaced_by: Standing dek no longer true (UAH now five wins in six); AUM beat Christian Brothers and are the only side with a perfect conference record.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Goals have not meant points: West Alabama have scored fourteen and conceded fourteen, and have won once in seven matches.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Five matches have passed their date with no result at all, the earliest Trevecca's at Belmont.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Spring Hill have scored one goal in five matches and have lost four of them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hunter Walker has conceded six goals for Trevecca and kept three clean sheets.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: West Alabama's fourteen goals have come from seven different scorers.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Patrick Schott has made 42 saves for Union and has conceded ten goals.

last_match.line: AUM have still not conceded in conference play, and Christian Brothers had not lost in it until now.

next_match.line: West Alabama's only win came at home against Tuskegee; Delta State and Christian Brothers have both already won at Harding.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
